title: Hatthārohaputta
html:
• Theragāthā 1.77 Verses of the Senior Monks 1.77
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Aṭṭhamavagga Chapter Eight

Hatthārohaputtattheragāthā Hatthārohaputta

“Idaṁ pure cittamacāri cārikaṁ, In the past my mind wandered Yenicchakaṁ yatthakāmaṁ yathāsukhaṁ; how it wished, where it liked, as it pleased. Tadajjahaṁ niggahessāmi yoniso, Now I’ll carefully guide it, Hatthippabhinnaṁ viya aṅkusaggaho”ti. as a trainer with a hook guides a rutting elephant.

… Hatthārohaputto thero ….
